title: Teacher's Day card
summary: A handmade pop-up card designed and written by the team for Teacher's Day.
description: For Teacher's Day, the team made a handwritten pop-up card. Inside, it reads: "A great teacher can inspire, guide and change a life forever." and "Happy Teachers Day!!! You plant the seeds of knowledge today, that grow forever." — signed, MaOM Group 16.

title: Compassion Project
summary: Public Water Bowl – A Compassion Project for Animals & Birds.
description: As part of the MaOM (Mastery Over Mind) Compassion Project, We took the initiative to promote kindness towards animals by providing a designated place for food and water in suitable public areas. This activity aims to help stray animals and birds access clean drinking water, encourage compassion for all living beings, and create awareness about our responsibility towards the community. Through this small initiative, we hope to spread kindness and make the environment safer and more caring for animals. — signed, MaOM Group 16.

title: Inktober Activity
summary: Inktober activity by creating a short character animation, showcasing creativity, visual storytelling, and animation skills.
description: As part of the Inktober activity, We explored creativity and visual storytelling through character design and animation. The activity involved bringing illustrated characters to life through movement, expressions, and a simple animated scene. It provided an opportunity to develop imagination, artistic skills, and storytelling abilities while learning how small details can make a visual story more engaging. — signed, MaOM Group 16.
